Wedding.color_guidance: Rich jewel tones, gold accents, deep reds, royal blue, emerald green, champagne
Wedding.styling_tip: Focus on high-contrast embellishments, statement jewelry or lapel accessories, and structured traditional or black-tie footwear.

Diwali.color_guidance: Bright festive colors, marigold yellow, mustard, fuschia, royal blue, emerald, ruby red
Diwali.styling_tip: Pair bright festive attire with traditional motifs, metallic accessories, and comfortable festive footwear.

Business Meeting.color_guidance: Restrained neutrals, navy, charcoal, slate gray, ivory, beige, muted wine
Business Meeting.styling_tip: Prioritize sharp tailoring, clean lines, polished oxfords or closed-toe heels, and minimalist accessories.

Casual.color_guidance: Earthy tones, soft neutrals, pastels, muted primaries
Casual.styling_tip: Combine comfortable breathable separates with clean sneakers, loafers, or flat sandals.

Cocktail Party.color_guidance: Midnight black, emerald green, deep burgundy, metallic silver, champagne gold
Cocktail Party.styling_tip: Incorporate clean silhouette cuts, bold statement accessories, and sleek footwear.

College.color_guidance: Pastels, denims, monochrome, vibrant graphic hues
College.styling_tip: Focus on versatile layering, durable fabrics, ergonomic footwear, and minimal functional accessories.

Date Night.color_guidance: Blush pink, wine, deep navy, terracotta, classic black, warm ivory
Date Night.styling_tip: Balance soft draped textures with key statement pieces and complementary footwear.

Festival.color_guidance: Vibrant primary & secondary colors, coral, turquoise, saffron yellow, magenta
Festival.embroidery_level: Medium mirror work, Chikankari, or printed motifs
Festival.styling_tip: Opt for movement-friendly silhouettes, expressive patterns, and hand-crafted accents.

Formal Event.color_guidance: Classic black, navy blue, gold, silver, emerald, maroon
Formal Event.styling_tip: Ensure precision fit, dark polished accessories, and timeless styling details.

embroidery_and_motifs.Zardozi: Heavy metallic gold/silver threadwork with pearls and beads; suitable for weddings and formal royalty.
embroidery_and_motifs.Chikankari: Delicate white shadow threadwork on light fabrics; ideal for summer, casual, and festive daytime events.
embroidery_and_motifs.Gota Patti: Applique ribbon embroidery native to Rajasthan; vibrant for festive and wedding occasions.
embroidery_and_motifs.Kantha: Traditional running stitch work with artistic folk motifs; suitable for casual and semi-formal wear.
embroidery_and_motifs.Threadwork: Refined colorful thread stitching forming floral or geometric patterns.
embroidery_and_motifs.Pinstripes: Parallel clean lines ideal for corporate and formal western tailoring.
embroidery_and_motifs.Houndstooth: Dual-tone geometric weave pattern for classic outerwear and suits.
embroidery_and_motifs.Minimalist Stitching: Subtle tonal edge stitching for modern clean aesthetic.

Summer.styling_focus: Breathability, movement, light layering, UV protection.

Winter.styling_focus: Thermal layering, structured silhouettes, rich textures.

Monsoon.styling_focus: Ankle-length or mid-length hems, water-resilient accessories, anti-frizz hairstyles.

color_recommendations: All palettes applicable depending on occasion

Low.fabric_guidance: High-quality Cotton, Rayon, Linen blends, Crepe, Georgette.
Low.embroidery_guidance: Printed motifs, subtle machine threadwork, minimal lace trim.
Low.styling_focus: Focus on high-impact color pairing, sharp fitting, and smart accessorizing over heavy embellished garments.

Medium.fabric_guidance: Raw Silk, Organza, Fine Wool, Satin, Cotton-Silk, Chiffon.
Medium.embroidery_guidance: Intricate Chikankari, Gota Patti accents, refined threadwork, neat lapel construction.
Medium.styling_focus: Invest in a statement central piece (e.g., designer Dupatta, structured Blazer, or Silk Saree).

High.fabric_guidance: Pure Banarasi Silk, Handloom Kanjivaram, Heavy Velvet, Italian Tuxedo Wool, Brocade.
High.embroidery_guidance: Handcrafted Zardozi, real zari embroidery, custom bespoke motifs, crystal embellishments.
High.styling_focus: Bespoke tailoring, heirlooms, designer accessories, high jewellery, premium footwear.
